analysis.title: Prime HFs Update - Nov 20th at US Close
key_insights: On Nov 20, in an AI/tech sell-off, fundamental L/S hedge funds fell 1.2% (-1.8 SD), with roughly 75% of funds down on the day, driven by beta losses.
Fundamental L/S alpha was positive at +0.3% on the day, led by size and health care factors.
Fundamental L/S performance is down 2.1% month to date and up 7.0% year to date.
US-focused funds fell 1.6% (-2.6 SD), and are down 2.9% MTD and up 3.6% YTD.
Europe-focused funds fell 1.3% (-2.3 SD), and are down 2.3% MTD and up 5.4% YTD.
Systematic L/S managers were flat on average with wide dispersion across funds, and 60% finished lower. The systematic index is up 1.5% MTD and 17.7% YTD.
risk_factors: AI/tech sell-off produced beta-driven losses across fundamental L/S hedge funds, with US-focused funds hit hardest.
vol_and_positioning: Fundamental L/S hedge funds -1.2% on Nov 20 (-1.8 SD), about 75% of funds down, losses driven by beta. Alpha +0.3%, led by size and health care.
US-focused funds -1.6% (-2.6 SD) on the day, the largest standard-deviation move of the groups reported. Europe-focused funds -1.3% (-2.3 SD).
Systematic L/S managers flat on average, 60% finished lower, with wide dispersion across funds.
